title: Raid: Shard Market
objective: Mine green shards, stock the market bin for customers to buy, collect gold, and hire workers or upgrade the mine.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen to move the character with a virtual joystick.
core_loop: Collect green shards from the mine, carry them to the market bin to sell to customers, collect the earned gold, and spend it on worker and mine upgrades.
progression: Unlocking and upgrading worker pads (10 -> 40 -> 65 gold) to automate mining, alongside higher-tier mine (50 gold) and tower (1,500 gold) unlocks.
hook_idea: t=45.2-54.6s: Gathering and hauling a towering glowing stack of 91 green shards through the dungeon into the market bin.
